Name: Red Fox
Description: Clever and adaptable, the red fox lives in forests, fields, and city suburbs alike, hunting mice with a pounce so precise it can hear them moving under snow. Its rust-red coat, white-tipped tail, and black legs make it one of the most recognizable animals in the world.
CreationReflection: It is the little foxes that spoil the vines, not the great disasters but the small compromises. The Christian life is guarded in the small, daily choices.
Habitat: Woodlands, fields, and suburbs across the Northern Hemisphere.
